verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a public REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI specification, confirmed live by a probe. It ships an official JS SDK that wraps the API, API-key and OAuth authorization, and documented endpoints for checkouts, refunds and Cloud API reader payments. A community developer independently built an integration on the public API, and the managed MCP server and agent toolkit make it agent-drivable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
